description: Searchable entity lookup input that calls an async search provider after a configurable debounce, displays results in a dropdown, and binds to a typed value upon selection.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the single-select value changes.

parameters.name: MultiSelect
parameters.description: Enables multi-select mode: selections are tracked via SelectedValues and rendered as chips. Default false.

parameters.name: SelectedValues
parameters.description: The selected values in multi-select mode (source of truth when MultiSelect is true).

parameters.name: SelectedValuesChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the multi-select selection changes.

parameters.name: AllowCreateNew
parameters.description: Shows an inline "create new" row that calls DataProvider.CreateAsync. Requires DataProvider. Default false.

parameters.name: ShowRecent
parameters.description: Shows a "recent" group loaded from DataProvider.GetRecentAsync when the picker opens. Requires DataProvider. Default false.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Optional data provider that powers the create-new and recent-items features (opt-in). The main search still flows through SearchProvider.

parameters.name: ValueSelector
parameters.description: Extracts the value from an item.

parameters.name: DisplaySelector
parameters.description: Extracts the display text from an item.

examples.title: Entity picker for users
examples.code: <TmEntityPicker TItem="UserDto" TValue="Guid" @bind-Value="selectedUserId" SearchProvider="@SearchUsersAsync" ValueSelector="@(u => u.Id)" DisplaySelector="@(u => u.FullName)" Label="Assigned To" Placeholder="Search users..." />

examples.title: Entity picker with custom debounce and min search length
examples.code: <TmEntityPicker TItem="CompanyDto" TValue="int" @bind-Value="companyId" SearchProvider="@SearchCompaniesAsync" ValueSelector="@(c => c.Id)" DisplaySelector="@(c => c.Name)" Label="Company" MinSearchLength="3" Debounce="500" />
